# Publix

> Publix (publix.dk) is a breach notification service. Enter an email address to check if it appears in known data breaches — results are sent privately to your inbox, never shown in the browser.

## Stack

- Next.js 13 (Pages Router), TypeScript, Neo4j, Material-UI
- Breach sources: XposedOrNot, LeakCheck, HIBP Pro, Dehashed
